final_claim: For all n≥k≥0, Farhi B(n,k)=binom(n,k) iff for each prime p≤k, all digits below h_p=floor(log_p k) satisfy n_{p,i}≥k_{p,i}; the equality indicator has sharp period T_k=∏p^e_p and density ∏(p−k_{p,i})/p, with a quantified density-decay upper bound.
limitations: The indicator period is not the period of the full integer-valued binomial/lcm quotient.
